gaps.explanation: The proprietary funds already have a schedule in detail[]: Schedule of Receipts, Disbursements and Change in Fund Balance - Cash Basis - Budget and Actual - Proprietary Funds (p11), Transfers from other funds 189,007 and Transfers to other funds 52,000 (detail net +137,007). The accrual proprietary statement (p7) prints Transfers to other funds Water (352,000), Sewer (241,476), Nursing Home (833,913) = (1,427,389) and Transfers from other funds Water 123,240, Sewer 65,767 = 189,007; net (1,238,382). Transfers in agree (123,240 + 65,767 = 189,007 = the schedule's 189,007). Transfers out: cash-basis schedule 52,000 vs accrual statement 1,427,389 (difference 1,375,389 = the gap); the statement's transfers out include non-cash amounts (e.g. the whole Nursing Home column 833,913, which has no cash schedule activity). Adding the statement's per-fund transfers out would double count the schedule's 52,000 and mix bases; replacing it would mean dropping a printed schedule line. No fix. Governmental statement p5 other-financing rows (Grants and donations 3,168, Debt service (212,571), transfers) are all in detail[]; no mislabelled transfer lines.
